-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.InvCompact` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem mvcc.compactRightR_iff (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : mvcc.compactRightR s γ c
    ⊣⊢ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx (Qp.half 1) c ∗ mvcc.compactQueue γ c ∗ ∃ o, (mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ mvcc.q8
    o ∗ mvcc.isStopChan o.sstop ∗ mvcc.stopCloser o.sstop ∗ schedule.schedStopTok γ.sch) ∗
    mvcc.storeStopR s γ o

theorem mvcc.jobLease_return (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢ mvcc.jobLease
    s γ o -∗ mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ mvcc.q8 o -∗ £ 1 ={⊤}=∗ schedule.schedRunning γ.sch

def mvcc.storeCloserM (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  if mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb then mvcc.compactRightR s γ c else mvcc.storeCloser s γ

theorem mvcc.storeStopped_persistent (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : Persistent (mvcc.storeStopped γ)

theorem mvcc.storeStopR_reclaim (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢
    mvcc.storeStopR s γ o -∗ schedule.schedDone γ.sch -∗ £ 1 ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ mvcc.q8 o

def mvcc.compactChan (ch : GoChan) (Q : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γc, ownBroadcastChan ch γc Q Broadcast.Unknown)

def (sealed) mvcc.storeStopR (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : IProp GF

theorem mvcc.compactRightR_crev (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : mvcc.compactRightR s γ c
    ⊢ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx (Qp.half 1) c ∗ (mvcc.crevUB γ.idx (Qp.half 1) c -∗ mvcc.compactRightR s γ
    c)

theorem mvcc.compactRightR_take (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : mvcc.compactRightR s γ c
    ⊢ ∃ o, mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ mvcc.q8 o ∗ mvcc.compactQueue γ c ∗ (mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ mvcc.q8
    o -∗ mvcc.compactQueue γ c -∗ mvcc.compactRightR s γ c)

theorem mvcc.CompactSmall_of_logCh {log : mvcc.Log} (c : Int) (h : mvcc.logCh log < 2 ^ 62) :
    mvcc.CompactSmall log c

def mvcc.gensOk (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Prop :=
  ki.gens ≠ [] ∧ ∀ (i : Nat), i + 1 < ki.gens.length → (ki.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []

theorem mvcc.storeStopR_stopChan (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) :
    mvcc.storeStopR s γ o ⊢ mvcc.isStopChan o.sstop

def mvcc.keepSetIs (A : GMap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision Unit) (log : mvcc.Log)
    (c : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), (A !! mvcc.revVal r).isSome = true ↔ mvcc.keepAt log c r

theorem mvcc.fieldShareAt_acc (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) :
    mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ q o ⊢ mvcc.storeFields s o (DFrac.own q) ∗ □ mvcc.physOk s γ o ∗
    (mvcc.storeFields s o (DFrac.own q) -∗ mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ q o)

theorem mvcc.storeStopR_lease (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢
    mvcc.storeStopR s γ o -∗ schedule.schedRunning γ.sch -∗ £ 1 ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ mvcc.q8
    o ∗ mvcc.jobLease s γ o

def mvcc.compactCloser (ch : GoChan) (Q : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γc, ownBroadcastChan ch γc Q Broadcast.Pending)

theorem mvcc.barrierCtx_persistent (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) :
    Persistent (mvcc.barrierCtx ctx cd)

def mvcc.compactJobPre (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (rev : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.isStore s γ ∗
      (∃ o, mvcc.storeStopR s γ o) ∗
        ⌜mvcc.storeCmp γ⌝ ∗
          mvcc.crevLb γ.idx (sint.Z rev) ∗
            mvcc.kbWTSupplyM γ.kb ∗
              ∃ log,
                mvcc.idxCert γ.idx log ∗ mvcc.idxNevLb γ.idx log ∗ ⌜0 ≤ sint.Z rev ∧ sint.Z rev < ↑(List.length log)⌝)

def mvcc.barrierCtx (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜ctx = mvcc.todoCtxV⌝ ∨ context.isContext ctx cd)

def mvcc.compactDone (_s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (rev : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.compactedAt γ rev ∨ mvcc.storeStopped γ ∨ ∃ cd, context.ContextClosed cd.Done_gn)

def mvcc.jobFieldsInv (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) (gl : GName) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ mvcc.q8 o ∗ dghostVar gl (DFrac.own 1) () ∨
      dghostVar γ.sch.run (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) () ∨ schedule.schedDone γ.sch)

def mvcc.keepOfIs (A : GMap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision Unit) (log : mvcc.Log)
    (rev : w64) : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), (A !! mvcc.revVal r).isSome = true ↔ ∃ k, mvcc.kiKeep rev (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k) = some r

theorem mvcc.fieldShare_reclaim (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : ⊢
    mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ mvcc.q8 o -∗ mvcc.storeStopR s γ o -∗ schedule.schedDone γ.sch -∗ £ 1
    ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ (Qp.half 1).half o

def mvcc.jobFieldsN : Namespace :=
  (nroot.@"mvcc").@"jobFields"

def mvcc.availAdd (A : GMap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision Unit) : Option mvcc.Rev
    → GMap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision Unit :=
  match x✝ with
  | some r => <[mvcc.revVal r := ()]>A
  | none => A

theorem mvcc.compactJobPre_persistent (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (rev : w64) : Persistent
    (mvcc.compactJobPre s γ rev)

theorem mvcc.storeCloserM_on (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (h : mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb) :
    mvcc.storeCloserM s γ c ⊣⊢ mvcc.compactRightR s γ c

def mvcc.jobLease (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ gl,
      inv mvcc.jobFieldsN (mvcc.jobFieldsInv s γ o gl) ∗
        dghostVar gl (DFrac.own 1) () ∗ dghostVar γ.sch.run (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) () ∗ threadTok)

theorem mvcc.storeStopR_alloc (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) (E : CoPset) : ⊢
    mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ mvcc.q8 o -∗ mvcc.isStopChan o.sstop ={E}=∗ mvcc.storeStopR s γ o

def mvcc.q8 : Qp :=
  (Qp.half 1).half.half

theorem mvcc.storeStopR_persistent (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : Persistent
    (mvcc.storeStopR s γ o)

theorem mvcc.CompactSmall_of_cert (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) :
    mvcc.isStore s γ ∗ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx log ⊢ ⌜mvcc.CompactSmall log c⌝

theorem mvcc.compactRightR_of_closer (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (E : CoPset) : ⊢
    mvcc.storeCloser s γ -∗ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx (Qp.half 1) (-1) ={E}=∗ mvcc.compactRightR s γ (-1)

theorem mvcc.q8_add : mvcc.q8 + mvcc.q8 = (Qp.half 1).half

def mvcc.CompactSmall (log : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) : Prop :=
  (List.map List.length (List.take (c.toNat + 1) log)).sum < 2 ^ 62

theorem mvcc.compactChan_persistent (ch : GoChan) (Q : IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.compactChan ch
    Q)

def mvcc.storeStopped (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ c γc, dghostVar γ.sx DFrac.discard c ∗ ownBroadcastChan c γc iprop(True) Broadcast.Done)

theorem mvcc.run_half_whole (γs : schedule.SchedNames) : dghostVar γs.run (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ()
    ∗ dghostVar γs.run (DFrac.own 1) () ⊢ False

theorem mvcc.storeCloserM_off (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (h : ¬mvcc.kbCmpM γ.kb) :
    mvcc.storeCloserM s γ c ⊣⊢ mvcc.storeCloser s γ

def (sealed) mvcc.storeCloserR (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) : IProp GF

def mvcc.keepApply (A : GMap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision Unit) (atRev : w64) (ki
    : mvcc.KeyIndex) : GMap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision Unit :=
  if mvcc.kiIsEmpty ki = true then A
  else
    match mvcc.kiAvail atRev ki with
    | none => A
    | some r =>
      if mvcc.kiKeep atRev ki = some r then <[mvcc.revVal r := ()]>A
      else GMap.delete (mvcc.revVal r) <[mvcc.revVal r := ()]>A

def (sealed) mvcc.compactRightR (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : IProp GF

theorem mvcc.storeCloserM_close (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) : mvcc.storeCloserM s γ c
    ⊢ ∃ o q c', mvcc.fieldShareAt s γ q o ∗ mvcc.stopCloser o.sstop ∗ schedule.schedStopTok γ.sch ∗
    mvcc.compactQueue γ c'
